# Suzy Parker Games

> Suzy Parker Games is a small UK games studio — Philip, Theo and Ben — making delightful, confusing and highly unique puzzle games that make the player feel clever (especially when they are not!).

The studio's home page is a deck of illustrated cards; the text on those cards is summarised here.

## Games

- [The Middle Bit](https://the-middle-bit.co.uk/): A new Venn Diagram puzzle every day — spot what the seemingly unconnected have in common. Played in the browser, with or without an account. iPhone and Android apps are on the way.
- Wangle: A bit like a crossword and a maths problem had a baby, and then the baby fell in love with pop culture — angles taken to a whole new degree. In the pitching stage; no public release yet.
